bounds.domain: Three review calls with at most two concurrent, one proposal identifier and digest, two screen revisions, one path replacement, one dispatch.
bounds.projection: Each review owns its list and Files identity continuation. The latest call can publish cards or prune pins. A retained pin prevents refresh from authorizing a replacement object. Cancellation or supersession is observed when the awaited callback settles.
bounds.conformance: Real Chromium uses the shared coordinator and actual BrowserFiles IndexedDB transactions with BrowserStorageVolume. Controlled host ports supply proposal snapshots, approval/claim responses and a single-page localStorage journal. The check verifies resulting source/destination file bytes.
bounds.limits: Host ports do not prove server authorization, transport ordering, journal durability or multi-page journal atomicity. Native Files/OS access, multiple proposals, deletion/trash, unbounded review sequences and process recovery remain external. No untrusted caller control of the reproduced timing is established.

assumptions: No fairness is required. A cancelled or superseded continuation may retire its own result but cannot change current review bindings.
No fairness is required. Only a current list that omits the proposal retires its identity pin.

Weak fairness of list return, identity read and identity return. Each host callback eventually settles, including failed or cancelled callbacks. Three calls are admitted and cancellation does not itself force a non-cooperative callback to return.
No fairness is required. A list or identity callback may remain unresolved indefinitely.
